newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: RAM assigns AA3 rating to Syarikat Kayu Wangi bond.
newsitem.headline: RAM assigns AA3 rating to Syarikat Kayu Wangi bond.

text.p: Rating Agency Malaysia Bhd (RAM) said on Wednesday it had assigned a long-term rating of AA3 to Syarikat Kayu Wangi Bhd's proposed 45 million ringgit guaranteed bonds issue.

In a statement, RAM said the rating "was based upon the credit enhancement in the form of unconditional and irrevocable guarantee provided by Pacific Bank Bhd, which has been accorded a long term rating of AA3 by RAM."
Syarikat Kayu Wangi is involved in the manufacture and sale of timber products, and property development.
